resources.string: Show an on-screen controller in Anland and expose it to Linux as a standard evdev gamepad.
Controls: left/right sticks, D-pad, A/B/X/Y, LT/RT, LB/RB, Back/Start/Guide and L3/R3.
Root access is required. On Droidspaces, Anland exposes only its own virtual event device to the active container; host input devices remain hidden.
